notes: Site: Umbraco-headless SPA (sostrenegrene.com), Denmark market at /da (culture=da-DK, market=DK; confirmed via serverCultures/marketUrl in page state -- root domain with no locale defaults to /en-gb GB market, not Danish). Direct HTTP fetch worked throughout, no WAF/block; robots.txt is Allow: / with no Claude-specific disallow. Checked: main /da/produkter top-category tile list (11 tiles), footer nav (linkGroupBelowGraphics 'Shop' list), homepage embedded content blocks, and the full /da/sitemap.xml (37k lines) grepped for bestseller/popular/mest-solgte terms. FOUND: 'Populaert' (Popular) is the SITE'S OWN FIRST top-level nav tile at /da/produkter -- a genuine standalone top category (isTopCategory:true, categoryId='Popularity', contentId=16141), sitting alongside Bolig/Kreativitet/Fest/etc, i.e. the site's own equivalent of a Bestsellers/Popular Products PLP. Queried its backend listing endpoint (same /umbraco/api/catalog/search?categoryId=<id> API the prior Home-Decor pass used) with categoryId=Popularity: total=100, sortBy='popularity', reproduced identical across 6 repeat calls (fresh sessions + delayed re-checks) and invariant to pageSize (1/500/1000 all returned total=100) -- stable, trustworthy. Sample product names confirm a genuine sitewide mixed-category popularity listing (home decor, kitchenware, cleaning cloths, food syrup, etc), not a single-category filter. EXCLUDED after inspection: (1) homepage carousel block titled 'Bestsellers fra kollektionen' -- this is an A/B-test-variation ('konkret-social-proof') recommendation widget embedded in the homepage content stream (recommendationType=PopularViewed, capped numberOfRecommendations=16, viewType=Collection), with no own URL/page -- a marketing carousel, not a PLP. (2) /da/landing/populaere-mobler-og-interior ('Popular furniture and interior') -- same pattern: a 'topic' page whose product content is a capped recommendationsBlock (recommendationType=Popular, numberOfRecommendations=16, scoped to Furniture categoryId 11 only), not a real category listing with a site-reported total -- algorithmic widget, excluded. (3) /da/landing/paskens-bestsellers ('Easter's bestsellers') -- its actual on-page H1 is 'Sidste chance' (Last chance) with supplementary title 'Paaskens bestsellers' and urgency copy about securing the most popular EASTER products before they're gone -- a seasonal/Easter campaign page, not a year-round Bestsellers PLP; excluded as seasonal marketing despite the word 'bestsellers' in its slug. No site search endpoint could be confirmed (tried /umbraco/api/search/v2, got empty responses -- likely wrong endpoint), so relied on exhaustive navigation/sitemap coverage instead, which is thorough for this site (small, fully-enumerated category tree).
